closed_requisition_confirmation.description: Independent official evidence for the exact requisition confirms a material closed-status contradiction.

conflicting_official_records.description: Eligible independent current sources conflict, so the live policy abstains.

copied_repost_cluster.description: Several adjudicated copied-derived records share one group; the group cannot satisfy the two-independent-source live policy.

current_employer_careers_listing.description: Two current employer-controlled records independently support the same vacancy.

employer_identity_only.description: Employer identity is verified but vacancy-specific authorization correspondence is absent.

employment_type_conflict.description: Two current official sources confirm a material employment-type conflict for the matched requisition.

explicit_official_contradiction.description: Two independent official sources identify the same vacancy and consistently contradict its authorization status.

incomplete_insufficient_evidence.description: The advertisement lacks vacancy identifiers and details and available evidence is insufficient.

independent_field_corroboration.description: Two independent official sources agree on employer, title, requisition and vacancy fields.

independent_official_corroboration.description: Two distinct adjudicated independent official source groups currently corroborate the same vacancy.

material_title_conflict.description: Two current official sources confirm a material title conflict for the matched requisition.

missing_source_dates.description: Source dates are missing, leaving freshness unresolved.

official_location_conflict.description: Two current official sources confirm a material location conflict for the matched requisition.

similar_role_different_vacancy.description: A similar role belongs to a different vacancy and does not correspond to the advertised requisition.

stale_source_dates.description: Evidence is stale and cannot establish current vacancy authorization.

two_source_requisition_match.description: Two independent official sources match the exact requisition and current posting.

unadjudicated_candidate_lineage.description: Lineage is only a candidate or not assessed and therefore cannot count as independent confirmation.

unavailable_source.description: The source is unavailable, leaving insufficient evidence.

unknown_lineage_support.description: Support-looking evidence has unknown or missing lineage and is excluded by lineage-aware aggregation.

verified_current_status.description: Two adjudicated independent groups report a current matching vacancy.
